summary: Sega's watercolor-styled military tactical RPG series, spanning mainline BLiTZ tactics games, PSP sequels, a shut-down browser/mobile card spin-off, and the Valkyria Revolution action-RPG spin-off.

entries.title: Valkyria Chronicles
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with DLC content; PS4 Remastered for console preference

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for primary route.

primary.version: Windows PC release with included DLC content
primary.why: The Windows release offers the highest-resolution/flexible capture route and includes the post-release content that later Remastered versions also bundle.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version from Steam/GOG or another legitimate storefront; use PS4 Remastered or Switch only for console/portable preference.

all_releases.reason: skip: original version, but PC and remastered ports are higher fidelity/currently easier to capture.

all_releases.fidelity: PC port with flexible resolution/capture and bundled DLC content.
Remastered console release with improved resolution and included DLC.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route but no exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console version of the remastered content.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, not highest fidelity.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the highest-fidelity and complete route with the same DLC content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remastered versions improve resolution and bundle content but do not replace PC for capture flexibility.

emulation.notes: Use only with a legally owned/dumped PSP copy.

primary.why: Valkyria Chronicles II is a PSP-only sequel with no modern port or remaster.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PSP/PS Vita-compatible hardware with the original release, or use PPSSPP with a legally owned/dumped copy.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform and complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PSP is the only documented release platform.

entries.title: Valkyria Chronicles III

emulation.notes: Use only with a legally owned/dumped PSP copy.

primary.why: Extra Edition is the expanded PSP release, adding seven episodes and preserving save transfer from the original Japanese version.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Japanese PSP copy of Extra Edition on PSP/PS Vita-compatible hardware or PPSSPP with a legally owned/dumped copy; fan translation use is an archival choice, not an official release.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for completeness by Extra Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded Japan-only PSP edition with additional episodes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Extra Edition is the most complete official release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japan-only PSP title with no official Western release; fan translation is unofficial.

entries.title: Valkyria Chronicles Duel
entries.definitive_edition: No playable definitive edition; historical service only

emulation.notes: No current official play route documented.

primary.why: Duel launched first as a Japan-only browser/card game and later came to Android and iOS, but the service shut down in 2015; no current official play route exists.
primary.how_to_play: Do not plan a live playthrough unless a legitimate archival server/build is available; document this entry from public sources and preserved footage.

all_releases.reason: primary: original launch route, now shut down.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile service client tied to the same shut-down game.
all_releases.reason: skip: shut down and no exclusive content route.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile service client tied to the same shut-down game.
all_releases.reason: skip: shut down and no exclusive content route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The original browser service is the canonical route, but all official routes are shut down.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service shutdown makes this an archival documentation entry.

entries.title: Valkyria Revolution

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 backward compatibility for the primary route.

primary.why: The PS4 release is the lead/highest-fidelity console route for the action-RPG spin-off; Xbox One has no exclusive content and Vita is lower fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 version if covering the alternate-universe action-RPG spin-off; keep it separate from mainline tactical Valkyria Chronicles.

all_releases.reason: skip: no documented exclusive content over PS4.
skip: portable route with lower fidelity than PS4.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS4 is the best documented fidelity route and has the same content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spin-off in a separate fictional universe with action-RPG combat, not a mainline BLiTZ tactics game.

entries.title: Valkyria Chronicles 4
entries.definitive_edition: Valkyria Chronicles 4 Complete Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for primary route.

primary.version: Windows PC Complete Edition with DLC
primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity/capture-flexible release and the Complete Edition route includes the DLC story/content set; Switch and cloud versions are convenience routes.
primary.how_to_play: Play Valkyria Chronicles 4 Complete Edition on Windows for the base game plus DLC; use console versions only for platform preference.

all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route but no exclusive content over PC Complete Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Complete Edition/DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity and most complete route.
skip: no documented exclusive content over PC.
skip: portable route, not highest fidelity.
skip: Stadia is no longer a practical play route.
skip: no exclusive content and not ideal for archival capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Complete Edition is both the highest-fidelity and complete DLC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; cloud versions are availability routes rather than definitive editions.
